record.question: {You are analyzing the sequencing data of a tumor patient. The tumor tissue data of this patient is stored in the following files: {BRAF_edit1.fastq.gz}{BRAF_edit2.fastq.gz}. The data of the normal tissue is in {BRAF_normal1.fastq.gz}{BRAF_normal2.fastq.gz}. First, align the fastq data of the tumor and normal tissues using bwa, then use gatk_markduplicates for deduplication, and perform base quality score recalibration with gatk_bqsr to obtain bam files. Next, use gatk's mutect2 to identify somatic mutations, and further annotate the mutations using vcf_to_maf. Finally, recommend suitable drugs based on the mutation results.}
